# Project AgroScan

> Project AgroScan is a free, student-built AI and IoT agricultural technology ecosystem developed by
> Team AgroScan under the parent organisation Luminary Technicals. It combines two solar-powered field
> sensors (AgroSoilManager and AgroClimateManager) with an AI engine (AgroAI) and a farmer-facing app to
> give any farmer real-time soil, climate and crop guidance — free of cost, with offline support.
> Founder & Project Director: Ar. Abhinav Ranjan. Built and exhibited at Shemford Futuristic School,
> Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India.

## Key facts
- Cost to farmers: free, always.
- Hardware: AgroSoilManager (soil pH, moisture, temperature, light) and AgroClimateManager (rainfall, wind, temperature, humidity).
- AI engine "AgroAI": Crop Recommender Model, Fertilizer Optimization Model, Weather Intelligence Model, plus an offline rule engine.
- Measured performance: 91% soil test accuracy, 95% user satisfaction.
- Founder & Project Director: Abhinav Ranjan (portfolio: https://abhinavranjan.qzz.io).
- Parent organisation: Luminary Technicals.
- Live apps: https://agroscan-org.netlify.app (user), https://agroscan-dev.netlify.app (developer), https://agroscan-lumitech.netlify.app (updates).
